title: The Detective's Maxim
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
ciphertext: LP LJ I FIULPIR NLJPIOV PB PZVBMLJV CVXBMV BKV ZIJ HIPI. LKJVKJLCRA BKV CVSLKJ PB PTLJP XIFPJ PB JQLP PZVBMLVJ, LKJPVIH BX PZVBMLVJ PB JQLP XIFPJ.
plaintext: It is a capital mistake to theorise before one has data. Insensibly one begins to twist facts to suit theories, instead of theories to suit facts.
epilogue: Sherlock Holmes says it to Watson over an anonymous note. Within minutes the watermark tells him the paper was made in Bohemia, and one back-to-front sentence tells him the writer is German.
